sessions.phase_label: BigQuery dashboard migration, metric completion, and validation

requirements.title: Juniper Tide Primary Source Replacement
requirements.definition: Replace the obsolete Juniper Tide Funnel Metrics COMPLETE source with JuniperTide_DataStudio_metrics for dashboard content belonging to the primary source.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the primary-source replacement; retention of auxiliary sources, individual metric behavior, and the hidden Impact page are independently changeable Requirements.

requirements.title: Retain Juniper Tide Auxiliary Sources
requirements.definition: Keep the Juniper Tide data sources other than the specifically replaced Funnel Metrics COMPLETE source available where their data remains needed.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated from primary-source replacement because the client explicitly removes one source while retaining the others, and either rule could change independently.

requirements.title: HarborPaws Primary Source Replacement
requirements.definition: Connect applicable HarborPaws dashboard content to HarborPaws_DataStudio_Metrics and remove the superseded primary source.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers HarborPaws primary-source replacement, excluding the independently specified routing of order-level metrics through another connector.

requirements.title: HarborPaws Order-Level Source Routing
requirements.definition: Obtain HarborPaws order-level metrics from the designated separate connector rather than assuming they belong to the primary HarborPaws source.
requirements.boundary_note: This source-routing exception can be implemented or changed independently of the HarborPaws primary-source replacement and individual metric definitions.

requirements.title: Gross Sales Accuracy
requirements.definition: The Juniper Tide BigQuery-backed gross sales figure must match the corresponding source figure when evaluated with the applicable date range.
requirements.boundary_note: Gross sales is independently testable and is therefore separate from gross revenue, even though both were investigated in the same exchange.

requirements.title: Gross Revenue Accuracy
requirements.definition: The Juniper Tide BigQuery-backed gross revenue figure must match the corresponding source figure when evaluated with the applicable date range.
requirements.boundary_note: Gross revenue has its own observable value and acceptance criterion, so it remains separate from gross sales accuracy.

requirements.title: Automatic Main-Dashboard Date Range
requirements.definition: Automatically apply the intended date range on the main dashboard so its displayed metrics use the correct reporting period.
requirements.boundary_note: The automatic filter is a distinct dashboard behavior rather than an attribute of any single metric.

requirements.title: Total Orders Metric
requirements.definition: Provide the total Shopify order count required by the dashboard reports, including access through the appropriate source for each dashboard.
requirements.boundary_note: Represents one metric definition across supported dashboard contexts; the different HarborPaws connector path belongs to the separate source-routing Requirement.

requirements.title: Google Ads Spend Metric
requirements.definition: Provide a distinct Google Ads spend amount for the Juniper Tide dashboard.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated from Facebook Ads spend because each channel has an independently observable metric and can fail or change separately.

requirements.title: Facebook Ads Spend Metric
requirements.definition: Provide a distinct Facebook Ads spend amount for the Juniper Tide dashboard.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated from Google Ads spend because each channel has an independently observable metric and can fail or change separately.

requirements.title: Returning-Customer Orders Metric
requirements.definition: Provide the returning-customer order count needed by the dashboard.
requirements.boundary_note: This metric can be added, removed, or validated independently of total orders and items sold.

requirements.title: Items Sold Metric
requirements.definition: Provide the sold-item quantity needed by the dashboard.
requirements.boundary_note: Item quantity has an independent value and acceptance criterion and is not merely an attribute of the returning-customer order metric.

requirements.title: Net Profit Margin Metric
requirements.definition: Display net profit margin as a dashboard metric when required.
requirements.boundary_note: Retained as a historical Requirement because it was requested and then explicitly removed; it is separate from Total COGS despite their shared removal message.

requirements.title: Total COGS Metric
requirements.definition: Display total cost of goods sold as a dashboard metric when required.
requirements.boundary_note: Retained as a historical Requirement because it was requested and then explicitly removed; it remains distinct from net profit margin.

requirements.title: Shipping City Dimension
requirements.definition: Make the shipping-city field available for dashboard reporting and geographic breakdowns.
requirements.boundary_note: City is a report dimension with its own availability criterion, not an attribute of an order-count metric.

requirements.title: Customer ID Dimension
requirements.definition: Provide customer ID in the dashboard data so customer counts can be calculated.
requirements.boundary_note: Customer ID is an independently requested data dimension whose purpose is customer counting; refresh timing is implementation status rather than a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Keep Impact Page Disabled
requirements.definition: Keep the Impact page hidden and switched off, without migrating that page to the BigQuery data source.
requirements.boundary_note: The hidden state and migration exclusion are tightly coupled in the client's explicit decision; this exception can evolve independently of the active dashboard pages.
